manifesto.label: Manifesto
lines: I do not ship work that only looks good.
I carry the brand’s character into digital.
I unite design, software, and technology in one system.
Every project is built to be distinct and outcome-driven.

featured.label: Featured project
featured.title: A Next-Generation Digital Experience for a Traditional Furniture Brand
featured.blurb: For Wholesale Cabinet Creations we designed a high-performance web experience that reflects manufacturing quality online. The project was built end to end with custom animation, mobile performance, SEO foundations, and a content management system.
outcomes: A stronger, more premium brand presence online.
Improved mobile performance and user experience.
Content, media, and SEO managed in one panel.
featured.sceneBody: Performance, SEO, and content management in one system.
